scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Dart typed range sum
checks.code: void main() { var total=0; for(var n=1;n<=10;n++) { total+=n; } print(total); }

checks.name: Dart generic class and null safety
checks.code:
class Box<T> { final T value; Box(this.value); }
void main() { Box<int>? box=Box(6); print(box.value*2); }

checks.name: Dart records and switch expression
checks.code:
int area((int,int) shape) => switch(shape) { (var w,var h) => w*h };
void main() { print(area((3,4))); }

checks.name: Dart async Future
checks.code: Future<void> main() async { final value=await Future<int>.delayed(Duration(milliseconds:5),()=>42); print(value); }

checks.name: Dart multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code:
import "dart:io"; import "dart:convert";
void main() { for(var i=0;i<2;i++) { final line=stdin.readLineSync(encoding:utf8); print("[$line]"); } }
